meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在已有的 Dial 通道上再添加一个电话号码，把它设为独立的公开线路。每个号码有独立的会话线程，别人发来短信或 AI 语音来电时，代理会从收到消息的那个号码回复。现有线路不受影响。
howto.when: 当 Dial 通道已经安装，操作者想为同一个 NanoClaw 安装增加第二个（或更多）电话号码时触发。必须已有 Dial 通道，否则需先执行 /add-dial。

say.text: 给 Dial 频道增加一个号码 +14155550123，分配给客服组。
say.note: 会创建该号码的独立线路并接入指定的 agent 组。

say.text: 再添加一个公开号码，名字叫支持专线，允许所有人接入。
say.note: 会询问选择号码和 agent 组，然后完成配置。

say.text: 把 14155550124 设为严格模式，只允许已知用户拨打。
say.note: 会校验号码归属后配置访问权限。

howto.what_en: Adds another phone number to an existing Dial channel as a separate threaded public line. The agent replies from whichever number received the SMS or AI voice call. Existing lines unchanged.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires an existing Dial channel; run /add-dial first if not present.

say_en.text: Add number +14155550123 to Dial for the support group.
say_en.note: Creates a separate line for that number connected to the chosen agent group.

say_en.text: Add another public line named Support Hotline, open to everyone.
say_en.note: Prompts for number and agent group, then wires it up.

say_en.text: Set 14155550124 to strict mode, only known users.
say_en.note: Verifies ownership and sets access policy.
